title: A Counterexample to Problem 19 on Integer-valued Polynomial Rings
summary: We give a negative answer to Problem 19 of Cahen, Fontana, Frisch, and Glaz concerning the flatness and freeness of rings of integer-valued polynomials. We construct an explicit one-dimensional Noetherian local domain D over the field with two elements and prove that the ring of integer-valued polynomials on D is not flat as a D-module. The argument shows that a certain polynomial is integer-valued on D with values in the integral closure T of D, but does not belong to the product of T with the ring of integer-valued polynomials on D.
